scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w database
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w worker && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -k "npm run start -w web" "npm run start -w api" "npm run start -w worker"
